rules.title: For You 推荐
rules.conclusion: 每次刷新推荐页，系统都会从关注内外收集帖子，经过过滤、预测打分和排序调整后生成列表。公开代码给出了这些步骤的实现。

sections.title: 候选来源
sections.conclusion: Thunder 提供已关注账号的近期帖子；Phoenix、SimClusters 和热门来源补充其他内容。
sections.detail: 公开参数为各来源设置了候选数量和时间限制，例如 Thunder 最多 1200 条，Phoenix 最多 1000 条。这些是默认上限，不是每次实际取到的数量。

sections.title: 排序前过滤
sections.conclusion: 去重、已经看过或展示过的帖子、屏蔽与静音条件会影响哪些内容进入排序。
sections.detail: 公开过滤规则还涉及旧帖、本人帖子、静音关键词、订阅资格及特定地区的限制。帖子被召回，并不等于有资格进入最终列表。

sections.title: 预测和打分
sections.conclusion: Phoenix 预测观看者点赞、回复、分享、点开或停留等行为的可能性；RankingScorer 按各项权重合成分数。
sections.detail: 多数权重作用于预测概率，部分作用于预测的连续数值。已有互动次数不直接等于这一环节的得分。

sections.title: 排序调整
sections.conclusion: 初次打分后，作者多样性、关注外内容折扣、新作者提升等规则还会影响位置。
sections.detail: VMRanker 也会进一步重排。连续出现同一作者、内容过于相似等情况，不能只用初次打分解释。

sections.title: 可见性检查
sections.conclusion: 排到前面的帖子仍可能因可见性检查而无法展示。
sections.detail: 公开过滤代码包含 ALLOW、NOTICE、INTERSTITIAL、DROP 等结果。被标为 DROP 的帖子会被移除，相关父帖或引用关系也可能受到影响。

sections.title: 适用范围
sections.conclusion: 这里描述的是已公开的实现和默认参数，不是所有账号当前采用的完整配置。
sections.detail: 部分 Grox 提示文件和 botmaker 规则尚未公开；线上实验及特性开关也可能改变默认设置。

weights.title: 默认权重
weights.conclusion: 下列数值来自公开参数文件，共 30 项。每项权重都用于相应的模型预测结果，不能直接换算成一次点赞、回复或举报的固定分数。

sections.title: 互动与关注
sections.conclusion: 点赞、回复、转发、引用及不同分享方式分别计权。复制链接分享的默认权重是 20，点赞为 0.66。
sections.detail: 二者对应不同的预测概率。数值相除不能得到真实互动效果的倍数；互相关注回复加成也有独立的适用条件。

sections.title: 点击与停留
sections.conclusion: 点开帖子、打开链接、观看视频和停留时长使用不同参数。
sections.detail: 例如打开帖子为 0.3，打开链接为 0.2，点击后连续停留时长为 0.4。它们针对不同预测结果，并非相同单位的互动计数。

sections.title: 负面反馈
sections.conclusion: 不感兴趣、屏蔽、静音、举报及未停留使用负权重。举报的默认值为 -234。
sections.detail: 这些负值参与预测后的评分计算，不代表一条实际举报会直接扣除 234 分。

sections.title: 默认值为零
sections.conclusion: 公开参数中有 6 项默认权重为 0，包括部分视频观看及个人资料点击相关项目。
sections.detail: 零值表示这些项目在本组默认参数下不贡献对应加权项，不足以证明线上所有实验都不使用它们。

updates.title: 版本记录
updates.conclusion: 2026 年 10 月 24 日建立了首份中文基线。当前历史文件仍只有这一条记录，尚无后续登记的源码变更。

sections.detail: 2026 年 9 月，Under the Hood 报告增加了因法律要求而限制展示内容的相关信息。这些是已发生的公告，并非本次新变动。

rules.title: 推荐流程
rules.conclusion: 候选帖子来自关注内外。系统过滤不符合条件的内容，再按预测行为打分，并调整最终顺序。

sections.title: 来源
sections.conclusion: Thunder 负责关注账号；Phoenix、SimClusters 等补充关注外内容。

sections.title: 评分
sections.conclusion: 点赞、回复、分享、停留及负面反馈分别产生预测值，再按权重合成分数。

sections.title: 调整
sections.conclusion: 作者重复出现、关注外折扣和后续重排会影响位置。

sections.title: 过滤
sections.conclusion: 已看过、屏蔽、静音或不符合展示条件的内容可能被移除。

weights.title: 权重速览
weights.conclusion: 以下为公开默认值。权重乘模型预测结果，不等于一次实际互动的加减分。

sections.title: 互动
sections.conclusion: 点赞 0.66、回复 5、复制链接分享 20，分别作用于对应行为的预测概率。

sections.title: 传播与关注
sections.conclusion: 普通转发 1、引用 5、关注作者 4，分别独立计算。

sections.title: 负面反馈
sections.conclusion: 不感兴趣 -52.272、静音 -58.8、举报 -234，为负向加权项。

rules.title: For You recommendations
rules.conclusion: The feed draws posts from followed and unfollowed accounts, filters candidates, predicts engagement, and adjusts the ranking. These stages are visible in the published code.

sections.title: Candidate sources
sections.conclusion: Thunder supplies recent posts from followed accounts; Phoenix, SimClusters and trending sources add other posts.
sections.detail: Public defaults set candidate limits and age limits: for example, up to 1,200 from Thunder and 1,000 from Phoenix. Actual counts can differ.

sections.title: Filtering before ranking
sections.conclusion: Duplicates, already seen or served posts, blocked accounts and muted accounts can be excluded.
sections.detail: Other checks cover older posts, your own posts, muted words, subscriber-only content and geographic restrictions. Retrieval does not guarantee eligibility.

sections.title: Prediction and scoring
sections.conclusion: Phoenix predicts actions such as likes, replies, shares, opens and dwell; RankingScorer combines these predictions using weights.
sections.detail: Most weights multiply predicted probabilities; some multiply continuous predictions. Existing engagement counts are not the direct scores.

sections.title: Ranking adjustments
sections.conclusion: Author diversity, discounts for out-of-network posts and boosts for less-exposed authors can change ordering.
sections.detail: VMRanker performs additional reranking. Repeated authors and similar adjacent posts are not explained by the first score alone.

sections.title: Visibility checks
sections.conclusion: Even highly ranked posts may fail the final visibility checks.
sections.detail: The published filtering code includes ALLOW, NOTICE, INTERSTITIAL and DROP outcomes. DROP removes the post; related parents or quotes may also be affected.

sections.title: Scope
sections.conclusion: This describes published code and defaults, not the complete live configuration for every account.
sections.detail: Some Grox prompt files and botmaker rules are unpublished. Experiments and feature switches may override defaults.

weights.title: Default scoring weights
weights.conclusion: The 30 values come from the published parameters file. They weight model predictions and are not fixed points awarded for a real like, reply or report.

sections.title: Engagement and follows
sections.conclusion: Likes, replies, reposts, quotes and sharing methods have separate weights. Copy-link sharing defaults to 20; liking to 0.66.
sections.detail: They multiply different predicted probabilities. The ratio of these values is not a ratio of observed impact; a mutual-follow reply boost has additional conditions.

sections.title: Opens and dwell
sections.conclusion: Opening a post or link, watching video and dwelling each have separate parameters.
sections.detail: For example: post opens 0.3, link opens 0.2, and continuous post-click dwell 0.4. These represent different predictions, not interchangeable interaction counts.

sections.title: Negative feedback
sections.conclusion: Not interested, block, mute, report and not dwelling have negative weights. Reports default to -234.
sections.detail: A predicted probability contributes to the weighted score; a single actual report does not subtract 234 points.

sections.title: Zero defaults
sections.conclusion: Six published parameters default to zero, including some video-view and profile-open predictions.
sections.detail: Zero contributes no weight under these defaults, but other live experiments may use different values.

updates.title: Version history
updates.conclusion: The first reference snapshot was recorded on October 24, 2026. The history file currently contains no later source-code change entries.

sections.title: Initial reference
sections.conclusion: The first record corresponds to upstream commit 6258a154 and covers the README, parameter file and scoring code.
sections.detail: The date is when the reference was compiled, not the date of a newly deployed algorithm.

sections.title: Earlier official notes
sections.conclusion: In August 2026, the maintainers clarified that weights multiply predictions and published more details on filtering and parameters.
sections.detail: A September 2026 Under the Hood report added information about content limited by legal requirements. These were earlier announcements.

sections.title: What is tracked
sections.conclusion: Changes to the README, weight parameters and scoring source are tracked.
sections.detail: Weight changes record old and new defaults and their difference. Commits only touching other directories are not automatically algorithm updates.

rules.title: Recommendation pipeline
rules.conclusion: Candidates come from followed and unfollowed accounts. Eligibility checks, predicted actions and reranking determine what appears.

sections.title: Sources
sections.conclusion: Thunder covers followed accounts; Phoenix and SimClusters add out-of-network posts.

sections.title: Scores
sections.conclusion: Predicted likes, replies, shares, dwell and negative feedback are weighted.

sections.title: Reranking
sections.conclusion: Repeated authors, out-of-network discounts and later reranking affect positions.

sections.title: Filtering
sections.conclusion: Viewed, blocked, muted or visibility-restricted posts can be removed.

weights.title: Weights at a glance
weights.conclusion: These are public defaults multiplying model predictions, not points gained or lost per actual action.

sections.title: Engagement
sections.conclusion: Like 0.66, reply 5, copy-link share 20: separate predicted probabilities.

sections.title: Distribution and follows
sections.conclusion: Repost 1, quote 5, follow author 4: scored independently.

sections.title: Negative feedback
sections.conclusion: Not interested -52.272, mute -58.8, report -234: negative weighted terms.

rules.title: 為你推薦
rules.conclusion: 動態消息會從已追蹤及未追蹤的帳號取得貼文，經過篩選、行為預測、評分及重新排序。以下依公開程式碼整理。

sections.title: 候選來源
sections.conclusion: Thunder 提供已追蹤帳號的近期貼文；Phoenix、SimClusters 及熱門內容來源補充其他貼文。
sections.detail: 公開預設值設有候選數量與時間限制，例如 Thunder 最多 1,200 則，Phoenix 最多 1,000 則；實際取得數量可能不同。

sections.title: 排序前篩選
sections.conclusion: 重複、已看過或已顯示的貼文，以及封鎖和靜音條件，都會影響哪些內容進入排序。
sections.detail: 其他檢查包括舊貼文、自己的貼文、靜音關鍵字、訂閱權限及特定地區限制。找到候選貼文不代表一定會顯示。

sections.title: 預測與評分
sections.conclusion: Phoenix 預測讀者按讚、回覆、分享、點開或停留等行為；RankingScorer 以權重合成分數。
sections.detail: 多數權重乘上預測機率，部分乘上連續數值的預測結果。既有互動次數不是直接得分。

sections.title: 排序調整
sections.conclusion: 作者多樣性、未追蹤內容折扣及曝光較少作者的加成，都可能改變貼文的位置。
sections.detail: VMRanker 會再重新排序。同一作者連續出現或相鄰貼文太相似，不能只用初次評分解釋。

sections.title: 可見性檢查
sections.conclusion: 評分較高的貼文仍可能無法通過最後的可見性檢查。
sections.detail: 公開程式碼包含 ALLOW、NOTICE、INTERSTITIAL、DROP 等結果。DROP 會移除貼文，相關上層貼文或引用關係也可能受影響。

sections.title: 適用範圍
sections.conclusion: 這裡反映公開程式碼及預設參數，並不等於所有帳號正在使用的完整設定。
sections.detail: 部分 Grox 提示檔和 botmaker 規則尚未公開；線上實驗及功能開關也可能覆寫預設值。

weights.title: 預設權重
weights.conclusion: 下列 30 項數值來自公開參數檔。權重作用於模型預測結果，不代表一次實際按讚、回覆或檢舉可直接增加或扣除多少分。

sections.title: 互動與追蹤
sections.conclusion: 按讚、回覆、轉發、引用及不同分享方式分別計權。複製連結分享預設為 20，按讚為 0.66。
sections.detail: 這些數字乘的是不同的預測機率，不能用比值推算真實效果。互相關注回覆加成另有適用條件。

sections.title: 點開與停留
sections.conclusion: 點開貼文、開啟連結、觀看影片及停留時間，各有不同參數。
sections.detail: 例如開啟貼文 0.3、開啟連結 0.2、點開後持續停留 0.4；它們衡量不同預測結果。

sections.title: 負面回饋
sections.conclusion: 不感興趣、封鎖、靜音、檢舉及未停留使用負權重。檢舉預設為 -234。
sections.detail: 負值參與預測後的評分，不代表一次實際檢舉直接扣 234 分。

sections.title: 預設為零
sections.conclusion: 公開參數中有 6 項預設權重為 0，包括部分影片觀看及個人檔案點擊項目。
sections.detail: 零值表示在這組預設值中不貢獻該項加權分數，但線上實驗可能使用其他設定。
